hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *local.properties) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"local.properties contains plaintext keystore signing credentials and must not be read by Claude Code."}}';; esac

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$c" in *local.properties*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Command references local.properties, which contains plaintext keystore signing credentials."}}';; esac
